title: narcissus ornatus
intro: Narcissus ornatus, commonly known as the ornate narcissus or poeticus narcissus, is a species of flowering bulbous plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its delicate white flowers with a hint of yellow and its fragrant, sweet scent. The health benefits of Narcissus ornatus include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve cognitive function due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including galantamine, which has been shown to have a sedative effect, and other alkaloids that have antimicrobial and antispasmodic properties.
